OmaTasks now always shows synced text as plain text, so a task name can no longer make your computer fetch an image from someone else's server. It also gets past network paths that have gone dead.

## Fixed

- **A task name can no longer load a remote image.** The bar drew the next task's name in Qt's default text format, which treats a name such as `<img src=...>` as styled text and fetches the image, so anyone able to edit a task in a shared project could learn your network address and when the bar showed it. The name now appears exactly as written, in the bar and everywhere else. By @crmne; thanks @HANCORE-linux for the report in [omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace#12072](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace/issues/12072).
- **Syncing recovers from a dead network path.** After suspend or a Wi-Fi change, or with an IPv6 address left over from a VPN, a request could spend its whole timeout on addresses that never answer and report "Could not reach Todoist" on a working network. Each address now gets 4 seconds, alternating between IPv6 and IPv4, and a failed request is repeated once on a new connection when that cannot apply a change twice. By @crmne; thanks @keegan-sucks and @salmun-nister for [#2](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/issues/2).

## Validation

123 JavaScript tests, 24 composer UI checks, 18 list interaction checks, and 5 bar checks passed. QML parsing, shell syntax checks, and Omarchy plugin validation also passed. `tests/check-bar` runs the real bar widget, panel, and task details offscreen with an image tag in every synced field and a local server: the unfixed bar requested the image, and the fixed plugin requests nothing. `Notifier.py` was run on a private session bus to check that task names reach the body escaped. The dead network path fix was tested in a private network namespace against a local server, with the real helper and service.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omatasks.git --enable
```

Requires Omarchy Quattro and a Todoist account. Existing users can update the plugin through Omarchy.
